title: Shan Poetry Reader: Introductory Classical & Contemporary Verses (ပပ်ႉဝွၵ်းတႆး ၸၼ်ႉဢွၼ်)
author: University Shan Literature & Culture Association, Taunggyi (ၵေႃလိၵ်ႈလၢႆးလႄႈၾိင်ႈငႄႈတႆး ၸၼ်ႉၸွမ်တၢင်းလူင်)
genre: Tai-Shan Classical Metrics, Poetic Anthologies & Rhyme Pedagogy
description: Exquisite poetic primer compiled by university scholars and literati in Taunggyi, Shan State, documenting classical 4-syllable, 5-syllable, and 7-syllable rhyming meters (Kham Wak, Lik Long, Kham Fɯn). It presents lyrical poems celebrating natural beauty, monastic serenity, cultural nostalgia, agricultural rhythms, and fraternal love.
source: Shan Literature and Culture Association / Internet Archive (shan-poetry-reader)

sentences.text_roman: pap wawk tai nai cum luk hen can cawm ton ti taem awk moer pi 1997
sentences.assamese_script: এই টাই কবিতা সংকলনখন টাউংগী বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ৰ টাই সাহিত্য সন্থাই ১৯৯৭ চনত প্ৰকাশ কৰিছিল
sentences.free_translation_en: This Shan poetry anthology was published in 1997 by the University Shan Literature and Culture Association of Taunggyi.
sentences.free_translation_as: ১৯৯৭ চনত টাউংগী বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ৰ টাই ছাত্ৰ আৰু সাহিত্য সন্থাই এই সুন্দৰ টাই কবিতা সংকলনখন প্ৰকাশ কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Chau Ngi Lung

sentences.free_translation_en: Tai poetic verses are celebrated for their melodious internal rhymes, pitch harmonies, and lyrical cadence.

sentences.speaker: Nang Seng Pha

sentences.text_roman: ka tha wawk si seng mi poeng kap kai khaw kwam cwom thaew
